# Copied from the charts repository. Update together with the charts.
# One entry per line: "<kind> <value>". The contract test looks up every entry in ../codemie-helm-charts
# when that folder exists, and skips with a message when it is absent.
#   key          a key path of the values file of keycloak-helm or oauth2-proxy
#   text         a text the Keycloak chart templates hold (layout of the theme folder, marker, name rule)
#   layout       a path of the assets folder of the wrapper chart (script output)
#   brand-input  a line of codemie-ui/brand-inputs.txt (chart file, not script output)

# Child theme values (keycloak-helm)
key keycloakx.childTheme
key keycloakx.childTheme.enabled
key keycloakx.childTheme.name
key keycloakx.childTheme.folder
key keycloakx.childTheme.images

# Layout of the theme folder keycloak-helm/theme (the five paths the Keycloak script writes)
text login/theme.properties
text login/resources/css/brand.css
text login/resources/img/
text email/theme.properties
text email/messages/messages_en.properties

# Hook marker and the asset-name regex of the chart
text keycloak-child-theme
text ^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,99}$

# Realm values (oauth2-proxy)
key realm.displayName
key realm.themes.loginTheme
key realm.themes.emailTheme

# Assets layout of the wrapper chart (codemie-ui/assets)
layout brand.css
layout brand-config.json
layout platform/*
layout email/*
layout email/brand.yaml
layout keycloak

# chart file, not script output: codemie-ui/brand-inputs.txt
brand-input assets/brand.css
brand-input assets/brand-config.json
brand-input assets/platform/*
brand-input assets/email/*
